captions.detailed: A professional DSLR camera flash accessory rendered in a matte black finish. It features a tall main control body with a rectangular mounting foot at the bottom, a distinct side battery door panel, and a forward-facing flash head supported by a rear yoke. The head assembly is designed to swivel horizontally on a vertical revolute joint above the body, and tilt vertically on a horizontal revolute joint between the yoke arms.
captions.instruction: Generate a professional DSLR camera flash accessory with a tall main body, a bottom mounting foot, a distinct side battery door, and a forward-facing head assembly. The head should swivel horizontally on a vertical joint and tilt vertically between yoke arms.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a series of extruded boxes and cylinders, including a rectangular base foot and a distinct side panel for the battery door. Build the yoke assembly as a horizontal crossbar with vertical side arms. Model the flash head as a rounded rectangular box with a recessed front face for the flash lens, and connect the components using revolute joints for horizontal swivel and vertical tilt.
